{{Top|leg}}
A '''enviro-analyzer''' was a non-portable item of technology that received results of a scouting device, such as the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[REM-02]], and discovered what it was that the droid had seen. [[Deeve]], a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] of the [[Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services]], used an enviro-analyzer.
